verdict.falsifier: cycle 1: PAD fraction < 0.50, OR masking moves the final training loss by no more than the run-to-run floor
verdict.detail: half 1 survives (PAD fraction 0.9343 > 0.50), but the run-to-run floor measured exactly 0.0, so half 2's test -- 'the delta exceeds the floor' -- is satisfied by one float ulp and discriminates nothing on this device
